slskd.Transfers.Batch.description:
A Transfer Batch is a lightweight association between a number of related Transfer
                    records and optionally the associated Search the Transfers are intended to fulfil.

Transfers may be enqueued in a Batch, and a caller that enqueued a Batch may use the
                    available API(s) to determine whether all of the Transfers within the Batch are complete,
                    but otherwise a Batch serves no functional purpose within the application.

Gets the optional destination directory for the files in the Batch, relative to the configured
download directory.

batchId.description: Gets the associated slskd.Transfers.Batch.Id, if one was specified when the Transfer was created.

id.description: Gets the unique identifier for the Transfer.

username.description: Gets the remote username associated with the Transfer.

filename.description: Gets the remote filename of the file.

size.description: Gets or sets the remote size of the file.

requestedAt.description: Gets or sets the time at which the Transfer was requested from the remote peer.

enqueuedAt.description: Gets or sets the time at which the Transfer was enqueued, or null if the Transfer has not yet been enqueued.

startedAt.description:
Gets or sets the time at which the Transfer connection was established and data transfer began, or null if the
Transfer has not yet been started.

endedAt.description: Gets or sets the time at which the Transfer ended, or null if the Transfer has not yet started or is still in progress.

bytesTransferred.description: Gets or sets the number of bytes transferred.

averageSpeed.description: Gets or sets the average speed of the Transfer over the duration.

placeInQueue.description: Gets or sets the current place in line in the remote peer's queue, if place has been requested.

exception.description: Gets or sets the associated Exception, if the Transfer did not end successfully, or null if it did.

attempts.description: Gets or sets the number of attempts.  Incremented each time the Transfer is retried.

nextAttemptAt.description: Gets or sets the time at which the next retry attempt will be made, if applicable.

removed.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the Transfer has been removed from the UI.

slskd.Transfers.Transfer.description: A file Transfer between network peers.

isPrivileged.description: Gets a value indicating whether the user is privileged.
